name: Fullworld Climate Experimental (ProjectCog port)
description: DIAGNOSTIC PRESET — fullworld-grassland baseline (7168x4096) with the four ProjectCog climate-stack ports layered on top: anisotropic ridge fBm, multiplicative peak erosion, domain warp on T/H sample coords, and equator-gradient biome-threshold bias. Used to validate whether the latitude-band artifacts seen in the 512x512 Biome Lab sandbox are a scale artifact (small fetch distance) or a real per-row bug in the equator bias. KNOWN ISSUE: equator bias is currently computed per-row inside BiomeAssignPass, so horizontal bands may persist even with domain warp on; if visible at this scale, Phase B per-cell fix is needed. Same climate-sweep calibration as fullworld-grassland (MoisturePerSeaCell=0.4, LandDecay=0.15) so coastlines saturate ~640 sea tiles and dry interiors drift through forest -> grass -> savanna -> desert as expected.
